channel.title: Pearl Of Sean Boracay
channel.description: Premium Boracay island hopping tours, snorkeling adventures, and luxury ocean experiences.

item.title: Pearl of Sean Hopping Tour
item.description: Boracay's ultimate luxury ocean adventure. Experience high-energy water sports, a massive giant slide, and elite onboard song performances.

item.title: Boracay Land Tour
item.description: Explore the island's best spots in a 3-hour guided tour. Visit Bolabog's Leaning Coconut Tree, the majestic Keyhole, and the serene Puka Beach.

item.title: Ultimate Combo Package
item.description: Experience the best of both worlds! Combine the scenic beauty of our Land Tour with the luxury adventure of the Pearl of Sean Hopping Tour.
